posts.author: Vermin
posts.body:
I'd like to be able to visually represent equipment changes on a sprite. I know it CAN be done, my questions revolve around what would be the best way to go about doing it?
I know I will have to make different sprite sheet layers for all of the variables, and I know I'm going to have to use a plugin to be able to swap them around, but which plugin?
I have no problem paying for a plugin if need be, but I'd rather not spend $ on something and then find out that it won't suit my needs
IE: which plug in will allow me to layer things the way I want?
For example, say I have a sprite in a trenchcoat, I'd obviously want that as the top layer, covering the pants/shirt/etc. variables underneath it.
I'm pretty sure, that will be a DIFFERENT plugin from the plugin I would need (please correct me if I am wrong!) to actually implement the change of equipment.
So, I'm looking suggestions to avoid compatibility issues from the get-go, because there's no sense in getting one plugin to work, then finding out it won't work with another.
And I know some of you have been down that road.
Also, IS that approach even the best way to go about doing it?
Am I making this needlessly complex?
Would it be easier to just have different spritesheets of the same sprite with the variables already on them?
I already have the art/animation done, and they're all separate layers, but merging them wouldn't be a ton of work.
I realize I would have to have spritesheets to account for every variable combination, but I'm pretty much only doing this for the player character, so that cuts down on a bit of work.
Plus I already have to art laid out, so it's not like I would have to redraw every variable from scratch.
Any suggestions would be awesome.
Thanks for your time!
V!

posts.author: Vermin
posts.body:
That looks like it would work for me. Now the question is how well it (or will it) works with other plugins....
I'm trying to not mix and match between developers (as much as I am going to be able to anyway), since there will be less chances of things fighting each other.
I'm currently looking at a bunch of things from
@Eliaquim
, like the animation frames additions and the diagonal movement plugins, but I know I'll likely need something additional in order to implement the changes as they occur.
Thankfully, this is all a bit "down the road" for me at the moment. I'm gonna make a few mini games with no added additions to get myself familiar with the engine before I start adding non-stock options and work on anything large.
Thanks again!
V!

posts.author: Vermin
posts.body:
Ah, AI.... Yeah, that's gonna be a big NO from me, thanks for the heads up, I'll look elsewhere.
It's not that I don't WANT to do coding and script stuff, I just have a *lot* on my plate doing the art.
I'm one person, so I can either get things DONE that I can do really well, or fight with code, which I can NOT do really well.
Sooner or later I'll have to dive into that, but if something has already been made that will do what I want, I can use my time in far more productive ways than reinventing the wheel, ya know?
Thanks again for the heads up on that though, I seriously appreciate that.
V!
